cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(MyApp CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Include vendor.cmake to add all dependencies with CMake support
# This file is auto-generated by Qompoter and adds packages to CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH
include(vendor/vendor.cmake)

# Find the library using find_package()
# The package name should match the prefix of the *Config.cmake file
find_package(MyLibrary REQUIRED)

# Create the executable
add_executable(my-app src/main.cpp)

# Link against the library
# MyLibrary is the target defined in MyLibraryConfig.cmake
target_link_libraries(my-app PRIVATE MyLibrary)

# Optional: Print build information
message(STATUS "Building MyApp with MyLibrary")
